user_saw: Under QuickJS heap pressure, a Code Mode script received an injected array as a string and continued running tools without reporting an error.
summary: The fix uses the normalized namespace value already in the guest, eliminating a second JSON copy that could turn an array into text when allocation failed.
reasoning: The worker already called `safe(value.value)` before #114945 moved the controller into its own file. The July 1 checkout boundary already contains the JSON copy, its `String(value)` fallback, and a configurable QuickJS heap limit. The available offline history did not establish when that code first shipped or whether a later change first exposed silent array conversion.
